about: Verified facts of the 92 bright stars (key hip:<HIP>) and the 88 constellations (key: IAU abbreviation), the only facts their short texts may state. Every fact has a confidence: sure, or estimate (a text says « about » or leaves it out). Every number a text writes must be one of the numeric values of its entry or of common (scripts/check-sky-texts.mjs).
